description: Source code for exporting and serializing model parameters in PyTorch's mobile JIT, including classes and functions for pickling IValues, converting tensor maps to dictionaries, and saving parameters to files or streams.

classes.name: IValuePickler
classes.description: Class for serializing IValues using Pickle and writing to a file or stream.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IValue object into a pickle format and writes it.

methods.name: writeArchive
methods.description: Handles the process of pickling an IValue and writing tensor data and pickle data to the writer.

methods.name: tensor_map_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a map of tensor names to a c10::Dict.

methods.name: tensor_dict_to_mobile
methods.description: Creates a mobile Module with a single attribute holding the tensor dict.

methods.name: _save_parameters
methods.description: Saves model parameters to an output stream or file, using either flatbuffer or pickle serialization.
